title: Identifying musicians in a photograph of Papa Lane's band
summary: The interviewer and Brunis puzzle over Cardella, Reiner, and Ragas in the band picture.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered
